headline: What Does Take Two Interactive Software (TTWO) Confirming GTA VI Mean Now?
summary: Take-Two Interactive Software (NasdaqGS:TTWO) confirmed the official Grand Theft Auto VI launch date and reported unprecedented pre-order demand. The company released first quarter financial results that exceeded analyst revenue expectations and outlined current performance priorities. Management highlighted Grand Theft Auto VI as a key product focus, alongside broader portfolio and cost discipline plans.
